description.describe_ch: 本課程的目的在於系統性地教授行銷研究的方法與量化分析的實作，讓學生們學習如何透過行銷研究萃取消費者洞察，進而形塑策略的實務應用，協助學生能夠快速的接軌業界實務。
description.describe_eh: The purpose of this course is to systematically teach the methods of marketing research and the practical application of quantitative analysis, enabling students to learn how to extract consumer insights through marketing research and shape practical strategic applications. This helps students quickly align with industry practices and thesis research.

targets.describe_ch: 學生具備進階商管專業知識的應用
targets.describe_en: Students possess the application of advanced business management expertise.

targets.describe_en: Students possess applied skills in data communication.
